component.name: SoundHop
component.summary: Stream and share audio between local Linux and Windows machines seamlessly

description.p: SoundHop wraps PipeWire, PulseAudio, and Windows WASAPI in an automatic, self-healing workflow with zero-configuration LAN discovery, multi-room broadcast, persistent per-app routing, PIN/PSK pairing, an interactive TUI, and a native desktop system tray.
